name: My Succubus Lover
source:
The story revolves around Neyunse a very special lycanthrope,He is the king of all lycanthropes he comes from Aria a kingdom where

Everything is possible since, cat women, vampire demons and of course Succubos
Everything begins when He is sent from his birth to the Human world by his mother
Leandra and his dying father Sefirot.
Here Neyunse meets his future family who are Elune Lala (Adoptive Mother), Elune Nana (Sister), and Elune Yuto (Adoptive  Father)
Nevertheless Neyunse is admitted to a new school Where Yuzuki Akiyama will meet a student What Would Be Human?
How will this relationship evolve? Who is Yuzuki Akiyama in reality?
translation:
故事围绕着Neyunse展开，他是一个非常特殊的狼人，他是所有狼人之王，他来自Aria王国，在那里

一切皆有可能，因为猫女、吸血鬼恶魔，当然还有魅魔
一切都从他一出生就被母亲送到人间开始
莉安德拉和他垂死的父亲塞菲罗特。
在这里，涅云斯遇见了他未来的家人，艾露恩·拉拉（养母）、艾露恩·娜娜（妹妹）和艾露恩·尤托（养父）尽管如此，Neyunse考入了一所新学校，秋山柚月在那里遇到了一名学生，人类将会是什么？
这种关系将如何发展？现实中的秋山柚月是谁？
